title:
Complete Order Flow Indicator
Suite for NinjaTrader 8
subtitle: Explore our ecosystem of 9 professional tools. From auction analysis with Volume Profile and Footprint, to Bookmap-style market depth and liquidity visualization with Depth Chart and Depth Live. Maximum zero-latency performance and ready-to-trade preset templates.

advantages.title: Complete 360° Ecosystem
advantages.description: Everything you need in a single platform: from auction analysis and imbalances with Footprint and Volume Profile, to Bookmap-style liquidity and market depth tracking with Depth Chart and Depth Live.

advantages.title: Zero-Latency Proprietary Engine
advantages.description: Built with ultra-optimized native architecture. In real time, it processes millions of ticks with absolute fluidity and zero latency, even during market opens and high-impact news. For historical data, it eliminates the requirement to enable Tick Replay, drastically reducing load times and RAM consumption. Additionally, it features UpDownTick mode for markets like Forex or CFDs.

advantages.title: Graphic Versatility & Presets
advantages.description: Engineered with the highest visual standard on the market. Features dozens of configurable parameters to customize each tool in detail, alongside ready-to-import templates to tailor charts to your trading style.
